Text: Give Your enduring will, Almighty God, to all Your faithful. [t] For we will meet the Christ with and within works of justice. [*] In these works, and at His Judgment, we are His companions who embody His will. The Kingdom of Heaven is our hope and our home given to us
Changes: 2024-11-29 - Paul Prins: Revised this translation to flow better.
